response.overview: Left jobless and hopeless in the aftermath of war, Sidar unable to marry because of economic hardship begins searching for treasure at night with his childhood friend Fırat. With every shovel of earth, he digs deeper into his past. A late-night dig leads Sidar not to buried treasure, but to a far more haunting discovery: the remains of his father, who was killed years ago in a politically motivated, unsolved case.
response.title: Treasure (Ewr)
